title: Optional persona JSON (engage-forge critique pass)
description: Optional structured shape for personas supplied via --persona <path>. Free-text persona strings are accepted by the skill without this schema — the primary agent fills in plausible attributes when only a name is given.

goal.description: What the persona is trying to accomplish in the artefact being critiqued

context.description: Environmental or situational context (device, time pressure, distractions)
